subject: Space not working, \l and other commands working fine.

messages.author: 338a816fe92c75cd
messages.subject: Space not working, \l and other commands working fine.
parts:
I'm running R 3.0.2, vim 7.4, vim-r-plugin 0.9.9.9, vimcom 0.9-93, and tmux 1.8 on Arch Linux.

Space normally worked, but one time after starting vim & r, it simply stopped. I tried deleting all the related files in /tmp out of desperation, but to no avail. I probably didn't close R with \rq, but I most likely closed it with q() inside R.

I'm a bit at a loss. Naïvely rebooting has had no effect.

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Space not working, \l and other commands working fine.
parts:
I have the following in my vimrc:

if has("gui_running")
    inoremap <C-Space> <C-x><C-o>
else
    inoremap <Nul> <C-x><C-o>
endif
vmap <Space> <Plug>RDSendSelection
nmap <Space> <Plug>RDSendLine

The temporary files are not used to map keys.
